title: UK government publishes final 2025 official development assistance spending statistics
excerpt: The report provides data on international aid spending from January to December 2025.
bodyHtml:
The UK government published its final statistics on Official Development Assistance (ODA) spend for the period of January to December 2025 on October 28, 2026. This publication follows an initial release of the data on September 17, 2026.

The government stated that it has removed potentially sensitive information for UK ODA programmes in Afghanistan. This includes project titles, descriptions, channels of delivery, and sectors. The government cited the security situation in Afghanistan as the reason for these removals.

The publication includes a 40-page PDF document, various ODS format tables, and a factsheet regarding ODA gender equality and disability inclusion policy markers. The government also provided annexes 1, 2 and 3 as part of the documentation.
